title: Wool Rampage
description: Stand on your haystack and hold off a flock of furious sheep with a paintball marker and a garden hose. Wet sheep shrink, wet grass is slick, and slipping sheep roll back down the hill and bowl over the rest.
controls: Mouse aims; click or hold to fire; 1, 2, Q or the wheel switch paintball and hose; R reloads; WASD shuffles about on the stack. On touch, drag to aim, hold FIRE and tap SWAP.
